title: Laser Exhaust Underperformance
app: Bambu Lab printers, Prusa Connect, OctoPrint, Moonraker, LaserWeb, CNC.js, drybox sensors, and workshop telemetry via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=laserweb:job
| stats avg(exhaust_cfm) as avg_exhaust_cfm, min(exhaust_cfm) as min_exhaust_cfm by cutter
| where avg_exhaust_cfm<250 OR min_exhaust_cfm<200
| sort avg_exhaust_cfm
description: Uses LaserWeb job telemetry telemetry to monitor whether exhaust airflow is staying inside the safe range in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for extraction systems that are too weak for clean cutting, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest LaserWeb job telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Cutter table of average and minimum exhaust flow.
grandmaExplanation: It records whether exhaust airflow is staying inside the safe range so you can spot extraction systems that are too weak for clean cutting before it becomes annoying.
